content_sections.heading: About NCCT
content_sections.text: The National Council for Cooperative Training is an organisation of the Ministry of Cooperation, Govt. of India, with its office at 3, Siri Institution Area, August Kranti Marg, New Delhi-110016. It has Training Units/Institutes, of which VAMNICOM, University Road, Pune, is one. Both posts are on contract basis, initially for a period of 1 year.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: Secretary, National Council for Cooperative Training, 3 Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110 016. Applications are invited from willing and eligible candidates who can be relieved immediately on selection and are free from vigilance angle. The notice does not state the postal mode or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The qualification, experience and age limit are the same for both posts. Educational qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) or ICWA or M.Com. Experience: minimum 5 years of work experience in Accounts/Audit in Government Organization/Cooperative Department/Cooperative Organization in the level of Pay Matrix Level-7 as per 7th CPC. For candidates presently working in Private Sector/Universities, the CTC should be comparable with the pay scale prescribed for candidates working in Government/PSUs etc. Age limit: not exceeding 35 years. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age or any age relaxation. Each yearly extension with the 5% increment is done at the level of Secretary, NCCT. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail for each post.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Contract
content_sections.text: Tenure: initial appointment for one year, with performance assessed yearly. Extension depends on satisfactory performance, year to year, for a maximum of up to 3 years. Termination: for unsatisfactory performance, services end after one month's notice without reason or pay in lieu. On resignation, three months' notice or pay in lieu of notice period is to be deposited. Leave: 15 days in a calendar year, not carried forward; any other leave is without pay. No allowance except consolidated monthly remuneration, and no terminal benefit on termination of the contract. TA/DA for official tours may be allowed as admissible to officers in Pay Matrix Level-7... see note below.

content_sections.heading: NCCT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Accounts Officer assists the Director/Registrar in financial and accounts matters of the Institute. The notice lists 34 duties; the main ones are: Maintain books of accounts, cash books, ledgers, registers and other financial records. Prepare the Annual Budget and Revised Budget Estimates, and monitor budget allocation and expenditure. Check and process bills, vouchers, receipts and payments, and process salary, allowances, advances, reimbursements and vendor payments. Prepare Bank Reconciliation Statements and maintain accounts of Grants-in-Aid and other funds. Prepare Utilization Certificates, Statements of Expenditure and financial reports. Coordinate Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, C&AG Audit and other inspections, and prepare replies to audit observations. Ensure compliance with GFR, DFPR, NCCT guidelines and Government instructions, and timely deduction and deposit of TDS, GST and other statutory dues, wherever applicable. Examine purchase and procurement proposals from the financial point of view. Process pension, gratuity, leave encashment and other retirement benefit cases, and deal with GPF/NPS matters, as applicable. Operate and supervise computerized accounting systems, and supervise the staff in the Accounts Section. Perform any other work relating to Finance, Accounts, Budget and Audit as assigned by the Director, Registrar or Competent Authority. The Audit Officer assists the Director (Finance) in ensuring proper financial management, audit, financial control and compliance in NCCT and its Training Units/Institutes. The notice lists 34 responsibilities; the major ones are: Conduct and coordinate audit of NCCT Head Office and its Training Units/Institutes. Examine books of accounts, vouchers, bills, receipts, payments and other financial records. Review budget allocation, expenditure and utilization of funds, and examine Grant-in-Aid accounts of the Training Units. Verify Bank Reconciliation Statements, advances, deposits, stores and fixed assets. Check procurement, purchase, tenders, contracts and related financial transactions. Identify financial irregularities, excess expenditure, avoidable expenditure and other deficiencies. Prepare Audit Reports, Inspection Reports and Audit Notes, and suggest measures for improving financial control. Monitor compliance with audit observations and settlement of outstanding audit paras. Coordinate with Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, C&AG and other audit authorities. Assist in RTI matters relating to Finance and Audit, and in matters of CPF, pension and gratuity, wherever assigned. Supervise staff engaged in audit work, and perform other work relating to Audit, Finance, Accounts, Budget, Grants and Financial Control as assigned by the Director (Finance)/Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in NCCT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Accounts Officer at VAMNICOM, Pune, and 1 Audit Officer at NCCT Headquarters, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are to be sent within 30 days from the date of the revised advertisement, 25 November 2026, which is about 25 December 2026. Applications received after the last date are not considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Accounts Officer and Audit Officer posts?
faq.answer: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) or ICWA or M.Com, with minimum 5 years of work experience in Accounts/Audit in a Government Organization/Cooperative Department/Cooperative Organization at Pay Matrix Level-7 as per 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit for both posts is not exceeding 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Remuneration is CTC based, negotiable as per market standards and the last/current CTC drawn.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NCCT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application in the Annexure-I format to the Secretary, National Council for Cooperative Training, 3 Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110 016.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Candidates working in the Central Government, State Government, Union Territory, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Organisations, who can be relieved immediately on selection and are free from vigilance angle.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, both posts are on contract basis, initially for one year, with extension on yearly performance for a maximum of up to 3 years.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted as per criteria decided by NCCT, and only shortlisted candidates are invited for interview, with dates sent by email.

faq.question: Q10. Are allowances paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: No allowance is payable except the consolidated monthly remuneration, but TA/DA for official tours may be allowed as admissible to officers in Pay Matrix Level-9.
